headline: The Investment Trust of India appoints Rashesh Praful Shah as Manager and KMP
hook: New leadership takes charge at investment trust
summary: The Investment Trust of India Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Rashesh Praful Shah as the Manager, Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), and Senior Management Personnel of the company, effective November 04, 2026. This routine managerial appointment fills a key administrative role within the firm. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should note this internal leadership change as part of corporate governance updates.
why_it_matters: Routine management change with no immediate financial impact for shareholders.

headline: The Investment Trust of India reports financial results for September quarter
hook: September results declared by Investment Trust
summary: The Investment Trust Of India Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Retail investors can review the earnings filing on the exchange portal to assess the company's financial health during the quarter. The disclosure provides standard periodic performance data for the listed firm.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the financial health of your holding.

headline: ITI Ltd clarifies CFO and CEO portal filing error
summary: The Investment Trust of India Limited has issued a clarification to the stock exchanges regarding an inadvertent error on the BSE listing portal. The company mistakenly referred to a Chief Financial Officer instead of a Chief Executive Officer in a previous submission. This is a routine administrative correction with no financial or operational impact on the company. Retail investors can disregard this procedural filing as it does not affect business fundamentals.
why_it_matters: Zero financial impact on your investments
